description: Stormwater Management Inspections: January 2015 - Present is a dataset listed in Howard County open data portal (opendata.howardcountymd.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Howard County. This is a month-by-month list of all stormwater management inspections performed or overseen by the Stormwater Management Division in the Bureau of Environmental Services. The list includes: Inspection Year and Month, which is the year and month in which inspection field work, additional investigation, and reporting was completed. Coverage: Howard County, Maryland. The portal files it under the category Utilities and Public Works. Its tags are stormwater management inspection. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Public Works. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-howardcountymd-gov-portal.
